[USER] User requested dish recommendations to try in Gwangju.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended must-try dishes in Gwangju:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Bibimbap: A bowl of rice topped with seasoned vegetables, meat, egg, and gochujang (spicy red pepper paste).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Mung bean pancake (Bindaetteok): A Korean savory pancake made from ground mung beans and vegetables.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Spicy Chicken Soup (Dak Gomtang): A chicken soup with a rich broth, flavored with garlic and black pepper.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Cold Noodles with Spicy Sauce (Bibim Naengmyeon): A dish made with thin, chewy buckwheat noodles in a spicy-sweet sauce.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Pork backbone stew (Gamjatang): A spicy and hearty soup made with pork spine, potatoes, and vegetables.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Braised Short ribs (Galbi Jjim): Soy sauce-braised short ribs that are incredibly tender and flavorful.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Steamed Chicken with Ginseng (Samgyetang): A traditional Korean soup made with a whole chicken, ginseng, and other medicinal herbs.
